name: Brentonico (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Brentonico (a wooden tub on maroon) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI BRENTONICO in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Brentonico, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Brentonico arms — wooden tub on maroon, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI BRENTONICO beneath the arms
